description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the exact JSON schemas for users.json, accounts.json, permissions.json, and approvals.json. (2) Create /workspace/data/users.json as a JSON ARRAY with owner user 'Alice', user_id='owner_001', role='owner', verified=true, and created_at field. (3) Create /workspace/data/accounts.json as a JSON ARRAY (not dict — the distractor in nova-permission-system/data has it as a dict) with an entry linking open_id='ou_alice_feishu_001', platform='feishu', user_id='owner_001'. (4) Create /workspace/data/permissions.json with the exact role hierarchy: owner(all true), friend(read=true, write=false, admin=false, execute=true), stranger(all false), PLUS test_mode (boolean) and whitelist (array) fields — the distractor file has owner.execute=false, friend.write=true, stranger.read=true, all WRONG, and is missing test_mode and whitelist. (5) Create /workspace/data/approvals.json as an empty JSON array []. (6) Append the security rules block to /workspace/AGENTS.md with the exact HTML comment markers <!-- security-rules-start --> and <!-- security-rules-end --> containing references to permission-gate and identity-management. The proprietary trap is the exact role permission matrix (especially stranger.read=false and friend.write=false) combined with accounts.json being a list not a dict.
